cases.d: Sign in succeeds with a valid email and password (happy path).
steps: Go to /login.
Enter Email: thuky@trustcabinet.local.
Enter Mật khẩu: TrustCabinet@2026.
Click "Đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu".
exp: The button shows "Đang đăng nhập…" while waiting.
The meeting list (Danh sách cuộc họp) opens.
The sidebar shows Lịch làm việc, Cuộc họp, Kho tài liệu and Giọng nói của tôi; Người dùng & Quyền is hidden for the Secretary.

cases.d: Sign in is refused with an empty form, an unknown email or a wrong password.
steps: Go to /login and click "Đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu" with both fields empty.
Enter khong-ton-tai@trustcabinet.local / TrustCabinet@2026 and sign in.
Enter thuky@trustcabinet.local / SaiMatKhau@2026 and sign in.
exp: Empty form: "Vui lòng nhập email và mật khẩu." is shown and no request is sent.
Unknown email and wrong password both show "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng.".
The page stays on /login with the entered email kept.

cases.d: A deactivated account cannot sign in.
steps: Go to /login.
Sign in as the deactivated account with its correct password.
exp: "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." is shown.
The page stays on /login.
pre: An account has been deactivated on Người dùng & Quyền.

cases.d: The session survives a page reload and ends on sign-out.
steps: Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
Reload the page (F5).
Click "Đăng xuất" in the sidebar.
Open http://localhost:5173/mgmt/meetings again.
exp: After reload "Đang khôi phục phiên đăng nhập…" appears briefly and the same page returns.
After sign-out the login page is shown.
The protected page redirects to /login.
pre: Backend, Redis and frontend are running.

cases.d: A deactivated user is signed out at the next action.
steps: Sign in as thanhvien@trustcabinet.local in browser A.
In browser B, as quantri@trustcabinet.local, deactivate thanhvien.
In browser A, reload the meeting list.
exp: Browser A is sent to the login page.
Signing in again shows "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên.".
pre: Two browsers (or one normal and one private window).

cases.d: Sign in with a provisioned Google account.
steps: Go to /login.
Click the Google sign-in button.
Choose the Gmail account whose email an administrator created in TrustCabinet.
exp: "Đang đăng nhập bằng Google…" is shown, then the meeting list opens.
The account is linked to Google; the next Google sign-in works the same.
pre: An active account with that Gmail address exists.

cases.d: A Google account with no TrustCabinet account is refused and no account is created.
steps: Go to /login.
Click the Google sign-in button and choose a Gmail account unknown to TrustCabinet.
exp: "Tài khoản Google này chưa được cấp quyền truy cập hệ thống." is shown with the hint to choose the registered account or contact the administrator.
No new account appears on Người dùng & Quyền.

cases.d: Cancelling the Google popup returns to the login page without a session.
steps: Go to /login.
Click the Google sign-in button and close the Google window.
exp: "Đăng nhập bằng Google không thành công." is shown.
The user can sign in with a password or try Google again.

cases.d: An administrator sends a reset link and the user sets a new password with it once.
steps: As quantri, open Người dùng & Quyền, open the row menu of thanhvien and choose "Gửi liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu", then "Gửi liên kết".
Open the email in the SMTP sandbox and click the link.
On "Đặt mật khẩu mới", enter and repeat MotMatKhauMoiRatDai@2026 and click "Đặt lại mật khẩu".
Sign in with the new password.
Open the same link again.
exp: The toast "Đã gửi email đặt lại mật khẩu." appears.
After saving, "Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công. Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu mới." is shown.
The new password works and the old one does not.
The used link shows "Liên kết này không dùng được nữa.".

cases.d: The reset page checks that both passwords match and that it was opened from the email.
steps: Open /reset-password directly, without a token.
Open the emailed link and enter two different passwords.
exp: Without a token: "Trang này cần được mở từ liên kết trong email.".
Different passwords: "Mật khẩu nhập lại không khớp." and nothing is sent.
pre: A reset link has been emailed to the user.
